question: How many tracks does each media type have? Give media type name and count.
sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name

question: Which 3 customers from Canada have the highest total spend? Give first and last name.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many invoices were issued in March 2022?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) = '2022-03'

question: What is the average unit price of tracks in each genre? Give genre name and average price.
sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

question: List each employee's first name together with their manager's first name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, m.FirstName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
